about_the_game:
My Little Farm is a first-person cozy farming & homesteading simulator built around physical, hands-on interactions and calm daily routines.
Every task (planting, watering, harvesting, feeding animals, loading crates) is done manually, in a warm, readable world with almost no UI.

🌱 HANDS-ON FARMING

Plant seeds, water crops with buckets, cans, or hoses, and pull vegetables straight from the soil. Crop growth, water needs, and readiness are shown visually: no spreadsheets, no bars to manage.

🐄 CARE FOR ANIMALS

Raise chickens, cows, and sheep. Feed them, collect eggs, milk, and wool by hand, and choose how to use their products. Animals come in different colors, with special variants producing unique goods.

🚜 MOVE, LOAD, DELIVER

Gather crops and animal products into baskets, crates, and containers. Load them into trailers, drive your tractor or car, and deliver goods to local shops or online pickup vehicles. Nothing is automated, everything is tangible.

🛠 SIMPLE MACHINES, REAL ACTIONS

Operate grain mills, yogurt makers, and other small machines placed directly on your farm. Processing is physical, readable, and satisfying.

🌤 A COZY DAILY ROUTINE

Days flow from early morning to night with gentle lighting, weather, and ambient sound. Progress comes from repeating a calm, rewarding loop — tend the farm, sell your goods, expand slowly, rest, and begin again.

🎨 COZY REALISM, MINIMAL UI

Soft visuals, warm colors, and diegetic feedback replace complex menus. The world itself tells you what’s happening.

If you enjoy relaxing, chore-like gameplay loops, realistic interactions, and the quiet satisfaction of doing things properly, My Little Farm offers a grounded, immersive farming experience.

👉 Add to your Steam Wishlist and build your farm one physical action at a time.
